title: The check runner, the sweep, and the release candidate stay within declared latency targets
statement: The check runner, the sweep, and the release-candidate verification MUST each complete within the performance targets declared in law/targets/performance.json, measured by the registered sensor and metric each target names, and a run outside a target MUST surface as a finding rather than a silent pass.
rationale: Article 5 scores F5 x T7 and Article 16 sizes Cycle A for within-iteration use; the targets file holds the numbers so the invariant stays stable while thresholds move by decision.

strategy.rationale: Wall-time sensors emit numeric metrics compared deterministically against the declared targets.
